VSOL V1600G1-B 8-Port GPON OLT – High-Performance Optical Line Terminal

The VSOL V1600G1-B is a compact, 1U rack-mountable GPON OLT designed to deliver high-speed, reliable broadband services in various deployment scenarios, including remote areas, industrial parks, and commercial buildings.​


Key Features:

  • High-Speed GPON Ports: Equipped with 8 GPON ports supporting upstream speeds of 1.244 Gbps and downstream speeds of 2.488 Gbps, ensuring efficient data transmission.​
  • Versatile Uplink Options: Offers 4 GE (RJ45), 2 GE (SFP), and 2 10GE (SFP+) uplink ports, providing flexible connectivity options to suit various network requirements.​
  • Advanced Management Capabilities: Supports management through EMS, WEB, SNMP, Telnet, and CLI, allowing for comprehensive network monitoring and control.​
  • Enhanced Security Features: Incorporates LACP, STP, RSTP, and MSTP for uplink redundancy protection, along with RIP and OSPF protocols to ensure secure and stable network operations.​
  • Compact and Efficient Design: The 1U rack-mountable form factor is designed for easy installation in limited space environments, making it ideal for deployment in basements, low-voltage rooms, or small racks.​
  • Cost-Effective Deployment: The V1600G1-B reduces investment costs in trunk fibers, pipe engineering, and facilities, effectively lowering both CapEx and OpEx.​

Specifications:

Dimensions: 442 x 319 x 43.6 mm​

Weight: Approximately 4.05 kg​

Power Supply: AC: 100~240V, DC: -48V/-60V​

Operating Temperature: -20°C to +60°C​

Storage Temperature: -40°C to +70°C​

Relative Humidity: 5% to 95% (Non-condensing)​


The VSOL V1600G1-B 8-Port GPON OLT is an ideal solution for service providers seeking a reliable, scalable, and cost-effective platform to deliver high-speed broadband services to end-users.​
